what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1981?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011-FY2025. The 1981 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (140 pages) was searched for wage, gross, salary and payroll and found only aggregates (the county retirement example on p95, `Lunenburg's Payroll $949,233`), the `Special Details - Wages` lines (p99, p101) and the school staff rosters (p69-78), which name staff and start dates and print no pay (sources/data/report-tables/1981/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1981 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in fiscal 1982?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1981 annual town report records only the articles (p25: `The Salary Schedule proposed at this year's Town Meeting will contain only one new category`; p130: an article `by deleting the Classification and Salary Schedule voted on April 5, 1980, ... and substituting` the Personnel Board's) and not the schedule; searched for classification, salary schedule, step and grade (sources/data/report-tables/1981/). — closes: the Personnel Board's Classification and Salary Schedule proposed to the April 4, 1981 Annual Town Meeting.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in fiscal 1981, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1981 report prints the revolving funds' YEAR-END balances only, as lines of the general fund balance sheet (p105 `Other Revolving Funds`: Adult Education, School Lunch, School Athletic), and the School Department's own special accounts with balance on hand and spent (p89-91); no town-wide receipts-and-disbursements schedule by fund. Searched special revenue and revolving: the only hits are p91 and p105 (sources/data/report-tables/1981/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1981 special revenue fund ledger.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in fiscal 1981?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a separate capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1981 report prints no such schedule: its balance sheet carries `Appropriations for Capital Improvements` as reserve lines (p106) and the accountant's schedule lists each article (p112-120), so whether any project sat in a separate fund is not shown. Searched capital project, capital plan and capital improvement: no capital plan is printed (sources/data/report-tables/1981/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1981 capital projects fund ledger.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1982?
why: `report-valuation` holds valuation and tax history from the 2000-2010 reports. The 1981 report prints the total assessed valuation in prose (p3: real estate and personal property, in the NOT LANDED facts list), the tax rate falling from $54.00 to $44.00 per thousand (p13, prose), and a five-year recapitulation of the amount raised by taxation (p104, landed as `raised-by-taxation-five-year`); no valuation by property class, no overlay or new growth schedule. Searched valuation, overlay, levy, recapitulation, new growth (sources/data/report-tables/1981/). — closes: the Board of Assessors' fiscal 1982 tax rate recapitulation (DOR form LA-5).

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1981, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1981 report prints the Inspector of Weights and Measures only as budget lines (p101, p115, p131), as a receipt line `Sealing Fees 617.80` (p99) and as a proposed fee schedule (p135); no Sealer's report. Searched sealer, sealing, weights and measures across the whole text (sources/data/report-tables/1981/). — closes: the Inspector of Weights and Measures' 1981 annual report to the Town.
